SELECT r.fiscal_period_label, r.period_start_date, r.period_end_date, r.fully_loaded,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date) AS lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date) AS loads
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (3,4,5)

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'),
ctl AS (SELECT l.store_id, sum(net_amount) n FROM l WHERE store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT ctl.store_id, ctl.n, rpt.r, ctl.n-rpt.r diff FROM ctl FULL JOIN rpt USING(store_id) WHERE abs(coalesce(ctl.n,0)-coalesce(rpt.r,0))>0.5 OR ctl.store_id IS NULL OR rpt.store_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT -1, count(*), count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM l
UNION ALL
SELECT -2, count(*), 0, 0 FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1 OR count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT -3, count(*), sum(net_amount), 0 FROM l WHERE quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0

WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM l) dup_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM l GROUP BY receipt_id, product_key, quantity, net_amount, sale_ts_utc HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_content,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), ',') FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id>=900) rpt_extra,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE sale_date NOT IN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4)) outside,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l WHERE channel_code='ST' OR channel_code IS NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)=0)) x,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900) web_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=999) s999,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE p.category='ZZ Test') zz

WITH l AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT receipt_id, store_id, count(*) n, string_agg(CAST(line_no AS VARCHAR), ',') lns, any_value(quantity) q, any_value(net_amount) amt, any_value(etl_loaded_at) loaded, any_value(staff_purchase_flag) staff
FROM l GROUP BY receipt_id, store_id, product_key, quantity, net_amount, sale_ts_utc HAVING count(*)>1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 12

SELECT cs.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
